headline: Outcome of Board Meeting — Maruti Suzuki India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
summary: Q2 FY27 (consolidated): Revenue ₹53,356 Cr (+26.0% YoY, +1.7% QoQ); EBITDA (derived) ₹4,764 Cr (-6.3% YoY, margin 8.9%); PAT ₹2,466 Cr (-26.4% YoY, -28.4% QoQ).
raw_text: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

row_labels.pat_owners: Profit for the period attributable to : Owners of the Company

derivation.basis_note: Consolidated Statement of Financial Results (PDF p. 6 via vision, reported in ₹ million, normalised ×0.1 to ₹ crore). Columns L→R: Col 1='September 30, 2026', Col 2='June 30, 2026', Col 3='September 30, 2025' (mapped Current=Col 1, Previous=Col 2, Year-Ago=Col 3).
derivation.revenue_definition: Revenue from operations as printed ('Total Revenue from operations') (excludes Other Income of ₹413.60 Cr) = ₹53,355.50 Cr (Prev Q: ₹52,469.80 Cr; Year-ago Q: ₹42,344.20 Cr).
derivation.ebitda_formula: Derived (`derived`): Operating Profit (Revenue ₹53,355.50 Cr − Total Expenses ₹50,619.00 Cr + Finance Costs ₹67.70 Cr = ₹2,804.20 Cr) + D&A (₹1,959.90 Cr) = ₹4,764.10 Cr (8.93% margin; Prev Q: ₹4,313.30 Cr; Year-ago Q: ₹5,086.00 Cr).
derivation.pbt_basis: Printed row 'Profit before tax (III-IV+V+VI)' (no current-quarter exceptional items) = ₹3,219.10 Cr (Prev Q: ₹4,441.20 Cr; Year-ago Q: ₹4,339.30 Cr).
derivation.pat_basis: Printed row 'Profit for the period (VII-VIII)' = ₹2,466.10 Cr (Prev Q: ₹3,446.90 Cr; Year-ago Q: ₹3,349.00 Cr).

enrichment.highlights: Basis: Consolidated · Normalised from ₹ million (Page 6 via vision) · EBITDA derived
